2000.reason: Inclusive Globalization covered: majority benefit, developing-world growth, conflict confined to left-behind regions. Pernicious Globalization's WMD-use wild card also occurred.

2004.reason: Davos World covered: China- and India-led growth 2004-2019 and a less Western globalization. Pax Americana, A New Caliphate and Cycle of Fear each partly held.

2008.reason: No scenario covered. 2025 shows parts of several: Russia-China alignment, SCO/BRICS growth and US retreat (World Without the West); Sandy and passing 1.5C (October Surprise); the Galwan clash (BRICs' Bust-Up). None of their defining premises fully held: the West was not supplanted, there was no resource war, and states were not eclipsed.
